identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase I Study of JS108 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I, Open-label, First-in-human, Dose Escalation and Expansion Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Pharmacokinetic Profile of Recombinant Humanized Anti-Trop2 mAb-Tub196 Conjugate in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors.

statusModule.whyStopped: Sponsor has adjusted study development plan and terminated this clinical study.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase I, open-label, first-in-human clinical study designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, PK profile and efficacy of JS108 for patients with advanced solid tumors. This study is divided into 3 periods: dose escalation period, dose expansion period, and clinical expansion period.

armGroups.label: Dose Escalation
interventionNames: Drug: JS108 (recombinant humanized anti-Trop2 mAb-Tub196 conjugate for injection)

interventions.name: JS108 (recombinant humanized anti-Trop2 mAb-Tub196 conjugate for injection)
interventions.description:
Dose escalation period: JS108 is administered intravenously every three weeks (Q3W) at the dose corresponding to the enrolled dose cohort.

Dose expansion period: JS108 is administered intravenously Q3W at the corresponding dose.

Clinical expansion period: JS108 is administered intravenously Q3W at the recommended dose.

primaryOutcomes.measure: First Cycle Dose Limiting Toxicities (DLTs) In Order to Determine the Maximum Tolerated Dose(MTD)
primaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants that experienced dose limiting toxicities(DLTs) at given dose level.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: A minimum of 21 days after first infusion of study drug

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with adverse events (AEs)
primaryOutcomes.description: The adverse events will be evaluated in accordance with CTCAE v5.0. The investigator shall assess the relationship between the events and investigational product.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through study completion, an average of 1 year
